Bustem.com | Founding Engineer | NYC (On-site) | $140k–$180k + 0.25%–1.0%

Bustem helps e-commerce brands & more, find and shut down copycats, counterfeiters, and unauthorized sellers.

In <12 months: $3M+ ARR, 150+ brands, profitable, no outside capital.

We’re hiring a Founding Engineer to build the core systems behind detection + enforcement.

What you’ll do: Build real-time infringer detection (scraping + AI) Build automated enforcement systems (agents/workflows at scale) Own systems end-to-end (architecture → deployment → iteration)

Stack: Next.js, Postgres, modern backend infra, LLMs

You: Ship fast, high ownership Comfortable with ambiguity Build systems, not tickets

Why join: Profitable + real traction No legacy / no bureaucracy Direct impact on product + revenue Early enough to matter a lot

NYC in-person

Email: genci@bustem.co (send CV & GitHub / projects)
